pages.text: Hunt bosses for the 42 unique named weapons — in IridescentCraft, every Simply Swords unique is boss-drop-only.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Simply Swords weapons are the best weapons available. Every unique is assigned to a specific boss with a specific drop chance. They are trophies as much as they are tools.$(br2)$(bold)Weapon types:$() Greatswords, Longswords, Katanas, Spears, Staffs, Warglaives, Scythes, Sabres, and more.

$(bold)How to get them:$() Kill the matching boss. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon). There are no other sources.$(br2)$(bold)Enchanting compatibility:$() All Simply Swords uniques are fully compatible with Apotheosis enchanting and affix reforging. A unique weapon with Legendary affixes and max enchants is the endgame weapon ceiling.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() each unique carries its own tooltip, the standard weapons are all in JEI, and the full boss-to-weapon map is this Codex's $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Simply Swords Unique Weapons$(/l) entry.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick a target boss from that list and go earn your first unique.$()
